patterns.description: Create document table (NODES, CLUSTERNODES, JOURNAL, SETTINGS)
patterns.sqlTemplate: create table {T} (ID varchar(512) not null primary key, MODIFIED bigint, HASBINARY smallint, DELETEDONCE smallint, MODCOUNT bigint, CMODCOUNT bigint, DSIZE bigint, VERSION smallint, SDTYPE smallint, SDMAXREVTIME bigint, DATA varchar(16384), BDATA blob(1073741824))
patterns.exampleSql: create table NODES (ID varchar(512) not null primary key, MODIFIED bigint, HASBINARY smallint, DELETEDONCE smallint, MODCOUNT bigint, CMODCOUNT bigint, DSIZE bigint, VERSION smallint, SDTYPE smallint, SDMAXREVTIME bigint, DATA varchar(16384), BDATA blob(1073741824))

patterns.description: Create blob data table
patterns.sqlTemplate: create table DATASTORE_DATA (ID varchar(64) not null primary key, DATA blob)
patterns.exampleSql: create table DATASTORE_DATA (ID varchar(64) not null primary key, DATA blob)

patterns.description: Create blob metadata table
patterns.sqlTemplate: create table DATASTORE_META (ID varchar(64) not null primary key, LVL int, LASTMOD bigint)
patterns.exampleSql: create table DATASTORE_META (ID varchar(64) not null primary key, LVL int, LASTMOD bigint)

patterns.description: Insert document row with all columns
patterns.sqlTemplate: insert into {T}(ID, MODIFIED, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, DSIZE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA) values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,  2, ?, ?, ?, ?)
patterns.exampleSql: insert into NODES(ID, MODIFIED, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, DSIZE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA) values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,  2, ?, ?, ?, ?)

patterns.description: Insert blob binary data
patterns.sqlTemplate: insert into DATASTORE_DATA (ID, DATA) values (?, ?)
patterns.exampleSql: insert into DATASTORE_DATA (ID, DATA) values (?, ?)

patterns.description: Insert blob metadata
patterns.sqlTemplate: insert into DATASTORE_META (ID, LVL, LASTMOD) values (?, ?, ?)
patterns.exampleSql: insert into DATASTORE_META (ID, LVL, LASTMOD) values (?, ?, ?)

patterns.description: Select all columns by literal ID
patterns.sqlTemplate: select * from {T} where ID = '{id}'
patterns.exampleSql: select * from CLUSTERNODES where ID = '0'

patterns.description: Select specific columns by placeholder ID
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where ID = ?
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from NODES where ID = ?

patterns.description: Select with CASE expressions for conditional column nulling (cached read)
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns}, case when (MODCOUNT = ? and MODIFIED = ?) then null else DATA end as DATA, case when (MODCOUNT = ? and MODIFIED = ?) then null else BDATA end as BDATA from {T} where ID = ?
patterns.exampleSql: select MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, case when (MODCOUNT = ? and MODIFIED = ?) then null else DATA end as DATA, case when (MODCOUNT = ? and MODIFIED = ?) then null else BDATA end as BDATA from NODES where ID = ?

patterns.description: Select by ID range without limit
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where ID > ? and ID < ? order by ID
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from CLUSTERNODES where ID > ? and ID < ? order by ID

patterns.description: Select by ID range with FETCH FIRST limit
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where ID > ? and ID < ? order by ID FETCH FIRST {N} ROWS ONLY
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from NODES where ID > ? and ID < ? order by ID FETCH FIRST 201 ROWS ONLY

patterns.description: Select by ID list using IN clause
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where ID in (?,?,...)
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from NODES where ID in (?,?,?,?)

patterns.description: Select by ID list using nested IN clauses (overflow batching)
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where (ID in (?,?,...) or ID in (?,?,...))
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from NODES where (ID in (?,?) or ID in (?,?))

patterns.description: Select by MODIFIED timestamp with limit (journal/change queries)
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where MODIFIED >= '{value}' order by ID FETCH FIRST {N} ROWS ONLY
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from NODES where MODIFIED >= '1636643795' order by ID FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

patterns.description: Full document update (replace DATA, set all fields)
patterns.sqlTemplate: update {T} set MODIFIED = ?, HASBINARY = ?, DELETEDONCE = ?, MODCOUNT = ?, CMODCOUNT = ?, DSIZE = ?, DATA = ?,  VERSION = 2, BDATA = ? where ID = ? and MODCOUNT = ?
patterns.exampleSql: update NODES set MODIFIED = ?, HASBINARY = ?, DELETEDONCE = ?, MODCOUNT = ?, CMODCOUNT = ?, DSIZE = ?, DATA = ?,  VERSION = 2, BDATA = ? where ID = ? and MODCOUNT = ?

patterns.description: Append update (conditional MODIFIED, append DATA, increment DSIZE)
patterns.sqlTemplate: update {T} set MODIFIED = case when ? > MODIFIED then ? else MODIFIED end, HASBINARY = ?, DELETEDONCE = ?, MODCOUNT = ?, CMODCOUNT = ?, DSIZE = DSIZE + ?, VERSION = 2, DATA = DATA || CAST(? AS varchar(16384)) where ID = ? and MODCOUNT = ?
patterns.exampleSql: update NODES set MODIFIED = case when ? > MODIFIED then ? else MODIFIED end, HASBINARY = ?, DELETEDONCE = ?, MODCOUNT = ?, CMODCOUNT = ?, DSIZE = DSIZE + ?, VERSION = 2, DATA = DATA || CAST(? AS varchar(16384)) where ID = ? and MODCOUNT = ?

patterns.description: Delete documents by ID list (revision GC)
patterns.sqlTemplate: delete from {T} where ID in (?,?,...)
patterns.exampleSql: delete from NODES where ID in (?,?,?,?)

patterns.description: Delete document by ID with MODIFIED guard (revision GC)
patterns.sqlTemplate: delete from {T} where ID = ? and MODIFIED = ?
patterns.exampleSql: delete from NODES where ID = ? and MODIFIED = ?

patterns.description: Delete blob metadata entry (blob GC)
patterns.sqlTemplate: delete from DATASTORE_META where ID = ?
patterns.exampleSql: delete from DATASTORE_META where ID = ?

patterns.description: Delete blob data entry (blob GC)
patterns.sqlTemplate: delete from DATASTORE_DATA where ID = ?
patterns.exampleSql: delete from DATASTORE_DATA where ID = ?

patterns.description: Update blob metadata last-modified timestamp
patterns.sqlTemplate: update DATASTORE_META set LASTMOD = ? where ID = ?
patterns.exampleSql: update DATASTORE_META set LASTMOD = ? where ID = ?

patterns.description: Conditional update blob metadata last-modified (GC marking)
patterns.sqlTemplate: update DATASTORE_META set LASTMOD = ? where ID = ? and LASTMOD < ?
patterns.exampleSql: update DATASTORE_META set LASTMOD = ? where ID = ? and LASTMOD < ?

patterns.description: Select blob metadata by LASTMOD threshold (blob GC sweep)
patterns.sqlTemplate: select ID from DATASTORE_META where LASTMOD < ?
patterns.exampleSql: select ID from DATASTORE_META where LASTMOD < ?

patterns.description: Select by ID range with MODIFIED condition (journal queries)
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where ID > ? and ID < ? and MODIFIED >= ? order by ID FETCH FIRST {N} ROWS ONLY
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from JOURNAL where ID > ? and ID < ? and MODIFIED >= ? order by ID FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

patterns.description: Select minimum MODIFIED timestamp for deleted documents (revision GC)
patterns.sqlTemplate: select MIN(MODIFIED) from {T} where DELETEDONCE = ?
patterns.exampleSql: select MIN(MODIFIED) from NODES where DELETEDONCE = ?

patterns.description: Version GC scan: find deleted documents within a MODIFIED time window
patterns.sqlTemplate: select {columns} from {T} where DELETEDONCE = ? and MODIFIED < ? and MODIFIED >= ?
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, MODIFIED, MODCOUNT, CMODCOUNT, HASBINARY, DELETEDONCE, VERSION, SDTYPE, SDMAXREVTIME, DATA, BDATA from NODES where DELETEDONCE = ? and MODIFIED < ? and MODIFIED >= ?

patterns.description: Delete by MODIFIED timestamp range (journal GC)
patterns.sqlTemplate: delete from {T} where MODIFIED > ? and MODIFIED < ?
patterns.exampleSql: delete from JOURNAL where MODIFIED > ? and MODIFIED < ?

patterns.description: Select blob data by ID
patterns.sqlTemplate: select DATA from DATASTORE_DATA where ID = ?
patterns.exampleSql: select DATA from DATASTORE_DATA where ID = ?

patterns.description: Select blob metadata by ID
patterns.sqlTemplate: select ID, LVL, LASTMOD from DATASTORE_META where ID = ?
patterns.exampleSql: select ID, LVL, LASTMOD from DATASTORE_META where ID = ?

patterns.description: Create index on MODIFIED column
patterns.sqlTemplate: create index {T}_MOD on {T} (MODIFIED)
patterns.exampleSql: create index NODES_MOD on NODES (MODIFIED)

patterns.description: Create index on VERSION column
patterns.sqlTemplate: create index {T}_VSN on {T} (VERSION)
patterns.exampleSql: create index NODES_VSN on NODES (VERSION)

patterns.description: Create index on SDTYPE column
patterns.sqlTemplate: create index {T}_SDT on {T} (SDTYPE)
patterns.exampleSql: create index NODES_SDT on NODES (SDTYPE)

patterns.description: Create index on SDMAXREVTIME column
patterns.sqlTemplate: create index {T}_SDM on {T} (SDMAXREVTIME)
patterns.exampleSql: create index NODES_SDM on NODES (SDMAXREVTIME)
